attributes.board_name: Virginia Board of Nursing (APRNs jointly licensed with the Board of Medicine)

rules.alternatives: Base renewal requirement is current professional certification in the specialty from a Board-designated certifying agency. APRNs licensed before May 8, 2002 (or CNSs with retired certification) may instead complete 40 hours of CE in the specialty approved by a certifying agency or ACCME Category I.
rules.audit_note: Random audits by the Boards; provide evidence within 30 days. Keep records 4 years after the renewal period. Extensions or exemptions possible for disability, military service or disasters.

topics.who: APRNs with prescriptive authority: pharmacology or pharmacotherapeutics, in addition to the certification/CE requirement

rules.notes: The 8 hours apply only to APRNs with prescriptive authority; others meet renewal through national certification. Licenses renew biennially.
